title: RAII FloatBuffer: Rule of Five
hints: Copy-and-swap: write `swap()`, then `operator=(FloatBuffer other)` taking BY VALUE handles copy and move assignment, plus self-assignment, in one function.
The moved-from object must be valid and destructible: set its pointer to nullptr and size to 0 (`std::exchange` is handy).
Mark the move constructor, move assignment and swap `noexcept`, otherwise std::vector<FloatBuffer> copies on reallocation.
`new float[n]()` value-initializes (zeroes). Handle n == 0 (keep nullptr). delete[] on nullptr is a no-op.
